```swift override func becomeFirstResponder() -> Bool { let isFirstResponder = self.isFirstResponder let result = super.becomeFirstResponder() if isFirstResponder == false && self.isFirstResponder == true { customTextView.removeInteraction(nonEditableTextInteraction) customTextView.addInteraction(editableTextInteraction) } return result } override func resignFirstResponder() -> Bool { let isFirstResponder = self.isFirstResponder let result = super.resignFirstResponder() if isFirstResponder == true && self.isFirstResponder == false { customTextView.removeInteraction(editableTextInteraction) customTextView.addInteraction(nonEditableTextInteraction) } return result } ```
